MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any PC fails (PC1 exact-repeat hitRate not 1.0 per_hit not 50 tok, PC2 MEA binding not 1.0 or auditor not blocking 100% unverified writes, PC3 TTL/ETag probe not discriminating fresh vs stale with ~50% stale exercising ETag mismatch, PC4 non-vacuous mock not in [0.10,0.60]), or bijective formula detected (n*3200 or 250+500*int(10n)), or registry never consulted, or UNKNOWN never exercised (<5% UNKNOWN at n=1), or baselines starved (hitRate 0 at n=0 inside compared set), or degenerate CI [1,1] used as precision, or nonce reuse bypasses ETag, or frontier adapter cross-family adoption, or retrieval-use gap not logged, or NC1 shuffled shows rho>=0.35 p<0.01 (novelty confounded).
